International Conference & Workshop Organization

Prof. Themistocleous has co-organized major international workshops and conferences at the intersection of computational linguistics, artificial intelligence, and clinical brain sciences—most notably serving as Co-Chair and Co-Editor of the flagship RaPID Workshop Series held biennially at LREC.

Pedagogical Leadership & Program Design

Curriculum Innovation at the University of Oslo

  • Course Leader & Lecturer — UV9010: Research Ethics for PhD Candidates (2023–present), Faculty of Educational Sciences, University of Oslo. Redesigned the doctoral ethics syllabus and coordinated faculty seminars.
  • New Elective Course Architect (MA in Speech-Language Pathology): Designed the syllabi for SPED4040: Introduction to Linguistic Analysis (Introduksjon til lingvistisk analyse) and Computational and Artificial Intelligence Methods in Special Needs Education (Beregningsmetoder og kunstig intelligens i spesialundervisning).
  • Logopedi Curriculum Reform Collaborator (2023–present): Co-designed course plans, learning outcomes, and assessments for four core courses (SPED4201–4203 and SPED3012).
  • Certified in Higher Education Pedagogy (Universitetspedagogisk basiskompetanse), University of Oslo (2023–2024: UPED-LEAD, UPED-RESS Research Supervision, and Teaching & Learning in Higher Education).
